sql: select (select max(started_at)::text from bot_runs) as last_cycle, (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') as cands_10m, (select count(*) from live_orders where strategy='Dmmsell10' and created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-04 23:00:00+00') as new_orders_since_standdown, (select max(created_at)::text from live_orders where strategy='Dmmsell10') as last_dm10_order, (select count(*) from live_orders where strategy='Dmmsell10' and status in ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial')) as still_resting, now()::text as now_utc
